takeaway: DeepSeek's agent repo gained another 4,732 stars (to 14,480) and t3code accelerated to 3,750 a day; computer-use agents are the newest wave on GitHub. The radar's forecasts are in a weak patch (40%, 33%, 40% of the top 15) that predates its API measurements.

findings.heading: DeepSeek's agent repo: #1 for a second day
findings.text: deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype went from 9,748 to 14,480 stars, after +5,162 the day before, measured through the GitHub API.

findings.heading: t3code keeps accelerating
findings.text: pingdotgg/t3code gained 3,750 stars in a day (38,761 to 42,511), up from 2,538 the day before.

findings.heading: Computer-use agents arrive
findings.text: vercel-labs/agent-desktop, a computer-use CLI for AI agents, gained 2,275 stars in a day to 10,793; phone-harness, Mika and OpenMausBot also give agents a device to operate.

findings.heading: impeccable passes 100,000 stars
findings.text: The design skill reached 100,763 stars (+1,089 in a day); hallmark and unslop each added more than 1,000.

findings.heading: A third weak forecast
findings.text: The Oct 27 ranking got 40% of its top 15 right across 87 apps (random picks: about 17%), after 33% and 40%. The first forecast built mostly on API measurements is scored on Nov 8.

findings.heading: Peec AI passes $20M ARR
findings.text: The AI-search visibility platform says it passed $20M in annual recurring revenue. Read from search results.

caveats: 50 apps judged not to be AI apps are now left out of the ranking; their observations are kept.
Company figures today come from search-result summaries; Apple gave no Apple Intelligence user count.
Hugging Face and Hacker News remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
